name: Med-HALT
description: A benchmark and dataset designed to evaluate hallucinations in large language models within the medical domain, featuring reasoning and memory-based hallucination tests derived from multinational medical examinations.
reputation: A specialized medical hallucination benchmark that has been cited in work on medical LLM reliability, though it is not as widely established as major general-purpose benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on reducing hallucinations in LLMs for healthcare applications with a diverse multinational dataset.
